reuse.why: Replaces four inline midpoint copies (schedule-template, forecast, postTransactionForSchedule, preview) with the existing exported getScheduledAmount and changes the rule there.

duplication.why: Removes the duplicated midpoint logic; only updateActions keeps a redundant null/number dispatch around the helper that the helper already handles.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount, which both server and client consumers already import.

scope.why: Only the amount rule, its call sites, comments and tests.

maintainability.why: One definition for every planning path is easy to own; the leftover ternary in updateActions and a garbled preview comment are minor blemishes.

one_place.where: The furthest-from-zero rule is defined only in getScheduledAmount (shared/schedules.ts), used by schedule-template, forecast-schedules, updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule, computeSchedulePreviewTransactions and the client components.
